model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the parameter α and the BLEU score. The x-axis, labeled “α”, is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.95, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU”, is a linear scale ranging from 28.1 to 28.5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. A single blue line represents the BLEU score, beginning at approximately 28.3 at α = 0.1 and increasing to a peak value of approximately 28.5 at α = 0.7, followed by a decline to approximately 28.3 at α = 0.95.
